flags.message: The application manifest marks the 176-page PDF truncated. Supplied text ends during the state-court opposition near EA Appendix 79; later appendix materials and reply are unavailable. The examination order at EA Appendix 3–6 has page labels but little usable order text. The forecast therefore relies on competing party quotations/descriptions of the order's scope and cannot independently verify its limitations. Prediction completed; no case disposition was retrieved.
